name: research-reader
title: Research reader
description: Everything that reads and nothing that changes. Search, analyze, compare and summarize the stored conversations, find contradictions and near duplicates across them, and build a context packet for another model. Safe to hand to a collaborator, because nothing on this endpoint can save, change, delete or send anything: the only export is a formatted copy of a conversation you can already read.
instructions: This endpoint reads the stored conversations and changes nothing. Start with search_conversations for a term and semantic_search when the subject was discussed in different words than the question uses. Use build_context_graph rather than repeated searches when the question is about what this corpus knows as a whole. Cite the conversation id behind every claim; if the conversations do not answer the question, say so rather than filling the gap.
